name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: The WhatsApp Business Platform enables businesses to communicate with customers at scale through messaging, calling, and group functionalities.
access_note: Developers can get a free test WhatsApp account and phone number for testing, but full functionality and template messages often require approval and are subject to pricing.

evidence.quote: Authentication uses OAuth (not 2.0) access tokens, while permissions restrict access to specific resources.
When you get started with Cloud API, a test WhatsApp account, test Messaging account, and test business phone number are automatically created for you.
Templates are customizable messages that you can construct in advance of sending them. Template messages generally require approval before you can send them.
The WhatsApp Business Platform is built on Graph API and uses HTTP protocol. API requests include path, body, and header parameters.
Webhooks deliver JSON payloads to your server for message status updates, incoming messages, asynchronous error handling, and many other notification utilities.
